hooks.command: { read -r json; f=$(echo "$json" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath'); [ -z "$f" ] && exit 0; result=$(pnpm biome check --files-ignore-unknown=true "$f" 2>&1); [ $? -eq 0 ] && exit 0; jq -n --arg f "$f" --arg r "$result" '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","additionalContext":("Biome lint error in " + $f + ":\n" + $r)}}'; } 2>/dev/null || true
